title: Transactional Surface-Water Runtime Composition Readiness

scope.DIVDRA_runtime_subset: restricted serialized single-level positive DIVDRA only, using one authoritative scalar transfer and a non-authoritative spatial distribution field

mass_contract.equation: S1-S0 = dt*(q_drain_secondary + q_rapid + q_supply - q_discharge) + V_top_surface_exchange
mass_contract.same_quantities_rule: the exact physical quantities used to form candidate S1 are the only quantities eligible for accepted-ledger publication
mass_contract.mass_tolerance_role: numeric verification threshold only after all physical contributions are present; never permission to omit, invent, clip or double-book water

transaction_order: runtime subdivides [t0,t1] at every explicit control event before starting a physical trial
capture one committed kernel checkpoint including physical surface-water continuation state
derive WLS from authoritative SWST; never commit WLS as an independent fixed-weir physical state
for SWMAN=2 control-only subset, create trial WLSTAR from explicit event semantics or reuse committed WLSTAR exactly between events
resolve physically enabled q_supply_available before the D3 availability limiter; raw WSCAP alone is insufficient
apply only admitted D3 limiter domain; limiter-active mixed-sign secondary exchange remains held
evaluate trial drainage and soil/surface contributions without publishing mass
compose D4 fixed-weir SWQHR=1 balance for physical fixed-weir route and obtain candidate SWST plus actual q_supply and q_discharge
verify finite values, SWST>=0, 0<=q_supply<=q_supply_available, q_discharge>=0, complete contribution mask and exact physical mass identity within numeric roundoff verification
publish candidate through existing F-KT commit authority only after solver, temporal and mass acceptance
publish accepted mass ledger and accepted diagnostics exactly once with the same committed candidate
on rejection restore exact committed SWST and, when active, committed WLSTAR; publish zero accepted mass from that rejected trial

state_ownership.rollback_requirement: rejected trials must leave committed SWST, conditional WLSTAR, lineage, revision, committed time and accepted ledger unchanged

all_required: temporal acceptance succeeded under the active numerical policy
mass residual passes numeric roundoff verification
all physical capacity and sign constraints pass
no held automatic-capacity, SWQHR2, mixed-sign-limiter or unqualified DIVDRA branch was traversed
acceptance_contract.failure_action: reject/retry or return fail-closed; never partially publish state or mass
acceptance_contract.commit_atomicity: surface-water physical state and accepted mass publication are one accepted transaction outcome

nonclaims: no scientific qualification of drainage exchange-law physics
